data.body: Follow-up Change 4 pushed to Gerrit as change 1755 (docs-only): while finalizing, AC 7 ('docs/architecture.md records both splits AND the near-cap warning') was only partially met — the merged stack recorded the near-cap indicator but not the two module splits themselves. 1755 adds a precedent paragraph to the module-size section recording the pass1.py->container_stage.py and push.py->push_recovery.py splits (seams, one-way dependency, core-parameter late-binding). Awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, then submit + close.
